# Detailed configuration

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/config-reference.mjs from the derivation tables in
     runner/config/*.sh. Do not edit by hand. CI runs `node scripts/config-reference.mjs
     --check`. -->

This is not a supported surface: it lists every value the fourteen settings
([CONFIG.md](CONFIG.md)) derive, for the person who wants to see or change one. Each is
grouped under the setting that decides it, with what each of its choices derives.

**Override any of them** with a real environment variable: `export NAME=value` before
starting the runner. That is the one way; settings.json does not take these names. An
override is honoured as it always was, and `gaffer config show --all` marks it as coming
from the environment. A value marked _follows_ takes another value's; one marked
_from the setting_ is worked out from the setting's own value (its note says how).

## `GAFFER_MODE`

Who approves and merges agent work: supervised (a person approves every merge), lite (trivial work is approved by the reviewer agent, a person merges), graduated (only what each repository earned ships on its own), autonomous (agents approve, merge and push inside the OS sandbox), strict (autonomous, and the sandbox wraps the agent even under the environment opt-out).

Accepted: supervised, lite, graduated, autonomous, strict. Default: supervised. Its table: `runner/config/15-modes.sh`.

| Derived value | supervised (default) | lite | graduated | autonomous | strict | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_MODE` | `human` | `agent` | `agent` | `agent` | `agent` | who reviews in_review tickets: human, agent (a reviewer agent, never the implementer) or both (an agent screens, a person approves) |
| `DISPATCH_ALLOW_AGENT_APPROVE` | `0` | `1` | `0` | `1` | `1` | 1 = dispatch accepts an approval the runner makes on an agent reviewer verdict (the env floor) |
| `MERGE_ON_AGENT_REVIEW` | `0` | `0` | `0` | `1` | `1` | 1 (with AUTO_MERGE) = an agent-approved ticket merges with no person in the loop |
| `AUTO_MERGE` | `0` | `0` | `0` | `1` | `1` | 1 = an approved ticket lands on the default branch without a second click |
| `GAFFER_AUTO_PUSH` | `0` | `0` | `0` | `1` | `1` | 1 = landed agent work is pushed to origin (a plain git push, from the runner) |
| `MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE` | `0` | `0` | `0` | `1` | `1` | 1 = a lesson an agent proposes goes live without review |
| `GAFFER_MEMORY_AUTO_PROMOTE` | _follows_ `MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE` | _follows_ `MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE` | _follows_ `MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE` | _follows_ `MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE` | _follows_ `MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE` | follows MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE: 1 = a requirement distilled from a delivered ticket goes live at once; 0 = it lands as a draft |
| `GAFFER_SECURITY_REVIEW` | `1` | `1` | `1` | `1` | `1` | 1 = a delivery that touches a sensitive path gets a second, security-focused review; 0 disables the lane |
| `GAFFER_MERGE_LANE` | `1` | `1` | `1` | `1` | `1` | 1 = a tick lands a ticket that is ready to merge and allowed to (a person approved it, or it earned it); 0 = a person merges |
| `GAFFER_CONFLICT_RESOLVER` | `1` | `1` | `1` | `1` | `1` | 1 = a merge conflict is resolved by an agent and re-reviewed; 0 = the ticket waits for a person |
| `GAFFER_LITE_MAX_DIFF` | _(empty)_ | _(empty)_ | _(empty)_ | _(empty)_ | _(empty)_ | lite mode trivial-diff bounds as "lines=60 files=4" (the defaults) |
| `GAFFER_ALLOW_SELF_DELIVERY` | `0` | `0` | `0` | `0` | `0` | 1 = let the factory deliver to its own source (first-party dogfooding); 0 refuses |

## `GAFFER_DAILY_BUDGET_USD`

The most the factory may spend in one UTC day, in dollars; empty is no daily cap. A live run needs this or GAFFER_BUDGET_USD.

Accepted: usd. Default: (none). Its table: `runner/config/08-guards.sh`.

**Budget admission and reservations.** Every paid agent launch asks one admission
check right before it starts (`runner/lib/budget-admission.mjs`). A dollar cap is a
ceiling, so the calls already running hold their worst case against it: under any cap
an admitted launch books a `reservation` row in the usage ledger before the call
starts, for its `GAFFER_MAX_CALL_USD` per-call cap where set, else
`GAFFER_KILL_ESTIMATE_USD`, else $0.05. Reading the spend and booking the reservation
happen under one lock beside the ledger, so two launches never see the same headroom.
Spend plus open reservations must stay below the cap, and while other calls are in
flight a new call starts only if its own worst case fits beside them. When the call
books its real cost (measured or estimated) that row settles the reservation. A
reservation whose call died without booking keeps holding both caps until a crash
path books its kill estimate, the next launch on the same host settles it (with the
same labelled kill estimate, and only once its launcher is provably gone), or you run
`node runner/lib/usage-ledger.mjs --reconcile --usd <amount>` (`--open-reservations`
lists them). A reservation is never a reading: it carries no cost and no view counts
it as spend or as a call. Only the per-call cap bounds a call: without
`GAFFER_MAX_CALL_USD` the reservation is a floor, not a bound.

| Derived value | Value | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `GAFFER_PAUSE_ON_CAP` | `1` | 1 = a delivery that hits a turn or dollar cap is paused with its worktree kept, for a one-click Continue; 0 = park it and tear the worktree down |
| `GAFFER_USAGE_PAUSE_DEFAULT_MIN` | `60` | minutes admission pauses after a usage-limit refusal that printed no reset time (at least 10) |
| `GAFFER_KILL_ESTIMATE_USD` | `0.05` | dollars booked for a call killed or timed out before it reported its cost (the budget gates count it) |

Accepted: usd. Default: (none). Its table: `runner/config/05-budget.sh`.

| Derived value | Value | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `GAFFER_BUDGET_LOW_THRESHOLD` | `0` | the dollar headroom at or under which the router picks one tier cheaper: 20% of GAFFER_BUDGET_USD, 0 when it is unset |
| `GAFFER_REWORK_BUDGET_USD` | _follows_ `GAFFER_BUDGET_USD` | follows GAFFER_BUDGET_USD: the most one ticket may spend across its rework attempts; empty = no ceiling but the attempt cap |
| `GAFFER_MAX_CALL_USD` | _(empty)_ | a hard dollar cap on each agent call (claude --max-budget-usd); empty = none |
| `GAFFER_CHEAP_PHASES` | _(empty)_ | phases routed one tier cheaper whatever the budget (implement, review, clarify); empty = none |

## `GAFFER_CONCURRENCY`

How many tickets the factory delivers at once (1 to 64).

Accepted: count. Default: 1. Its table: `runner/config/13-stop.sh`.

**Two helper processes per tick.** A tick runs its dispatch CLI calls (`wg`) through
one long-lived dispatch process and its JSON helper calls through one long-lived JSON
process, over named pipes in `$GAFFER_DATA/wg-serve/`, instead of starting node for
each call. A call a server cannot run identically runs one-shot; a dispatch server
that dies or answers garbage fails that call (a `WG_SERVER_FAILED` line on stderr).
`GAFFER_WG_SERVE=0` runs every call one-shot (troubleshooting).

| Derived value | Value | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `MAX_CANDIDATES` | _from the setting (see note)_ | ready candidates one tick scans before it reports no work: 25 per worker, at most 100 (0 = the whole list) |
| `MAX_TICKS` | `5` | ticks per loop run (a cost guard) |
| `MAX_TICKS_PER_DAY` | `50` | ticks per UTC day across loop runs; 0 = off |
| `EMPTY_POLL_LIMIT` | `2` | the loop stops after this many empty polls in a row |
| `TICK_SLEEP` | `30` | seconds between ticks |
| `MAX_CONCURRENT_TICKETS_PER_REPO` | `1` | tickets in flight for one repository at once |
| `MAX_OPEN_AGENT_BRANCHES_PER_REPO` | `3` | unmerged gaffer/* branches a repository may hold before new claims for it wait (0 = no limit) |
| `MAX_OPEN_AGENT_PRS_PER_REPO` | `3` | tickets in review for a repository before new claims for it wait (0 = no limit) |
| `GAFFER_WG_SERVE` | `1` | 1 = a tick sends its dispatch CLI and JSON helper calls to two long-lived processes; 0 runs each as its own process (troubleshooting) |
| `DRY_RUN` | `1` | 1 = print what would happen and never call an agent; `gaffer run` passes 0 |

## Old settings.json keys

Before the fourteen, the dashboard wrote these to settings.json. Each is now decided by
the setting named here: the runner ignores the key with one warning naming that
setting, except where the old value is stricter than what the setting derives (it
would never widen autonomy or spend): then it still applies, and the warning says so.
`gaffer config show --json` lists what happened to each (`migration`).

| Old key | Decided now by | When the old value still applies |
|---|---|---|
| `DISPATCH_ALLOW_AGENT_APPROVE` | `GAFFER_MODE` | an old 0 (off) still applies where the setting derives 1 |
| `MERGE_ON_AGENT_REVIEW` | `GAFFER_MODE` | an old 0 (off) still applies where the setting derives 1 |
| `MEMORY_AUTO_APPROVE` | `GAFFER_MODE` | an old 0 (off) still applies where the setting derives 1 |
| `REVIEW_MODE` | `GAFFER_MODE` | an old value further along agent < human < both still applies |
| `AUTO_MERGE` | `GAFFER_MODE` | an old 0 (off) still applies where the setting derives 1 |

## Env reads without a default

None: every environment variable the code reads is a setting, a derived value, an
environment-only name, a deprecated name or an internal name. A new read with none of
those shows up here until it gets one.

### Removed

Nothing in Gaffer set these, so each held its built-in value, which is now fixed in the
code. A set one is ignored, and the config says so once on stderr.

| Removed name | What happens now |
|---|---|
| `GAFFER_REWORK_HISTORY_BYTES` | a rework prompt carries the last 8000 bytes of earlier attempts' feedback |
| `GAFFER_JUDGE_DIFF_BYTES` | the eval judge grades the first 120000 bytes of a diff |
| `GAFFER_MERGE_GATE_RETRIES` | a landing whose target moved is re-gated up to twice |
| `GAFFER_PREFLIGHT_LIVE_TIMEOUT` | the live preflight call gets 60 seconds |
| `GAFFER_ACCEPTANCE_TIMEOUT_MS` | one acceptance profile run gets 5 minutes |
| `GAFFER_AGENT_NAME` | the factory agent registers as gaffer-factory |
| `GAFFER_AGENT_EMAIL` | a greenfield repo's first commit is by gaffer-factory@users.noreply.invalid |
| `GAFFER_BUDGET_LOW_FRACTION` | the low-budget threshold is 20% of the ceiling (set GAFFER_BUDGET_LOW_THRESHOLD to change it) |
| `GAFFER_INHERIT_PLAN_TIMEOUT` | the inherit planner gets 60 seconds |
| `GAFFER_INHERIT_AMB_TIMEOUT` | the inherit ambiguity call gets 300 seconds |
| `GAFFER_ONBOARD_TIMEOUT` | onboarding calls follow GAFFER_TICK_TIMEOUT |
| `GAFFER_REAPPROVAL_ATTEMPTS` | a re-approval is tried 3 times |
| `GAFFER_TESTER_REPLAY_TIMEOUT_MS` | the tester's replay gets 10 minutes |
| `GAFFER_DECOMPOSE_MOCK` | a dry-run planner takes mockOutput from its request |
| `GAFFER_SPEC_AUTHOR_MOCK` | a dry-run spec author takes mockOutput from its request |
| `GAFFER_AGENT_ID_FILE` | the factory agent's id is kept in $GAFFER_DATA/agent_id |
| `GAFFER_REVIEWER_ID_FILE` | the reviewer's id is kept in $GAFFER_DATA/agent_reviewer_id |
| `GAFFER_EVAL_LEDGER` | the eval judge writes $GAFFER_DATA/eval-ledger.jsonl, the file the dashboard reads |

## Internal names (not knobs)

The code reads these too, but they are not settings: another component or a test sets
them, or they follow from a value above. They are listed so a name you meet in the code
is not a mystery; a run needs none of them set.

- **paths**: Paths derived from GAFFER_HOME, GAFFER_DATA or the runner directory; set GAFFER_HOME / GAFFER_DATA instead (a test may point one elsewhere). `DISPATCH_DIR`, `CREW_DIR`, `MEMORY_DIR`, `DISPATCH_DB`, `MEMORY_DB`, `CREW_CONFIG`, `MEMORY_AUDIT_LOG`, `MCP_CONFIG`, `CLAUDE_SETTINGS`, `SKILLS_DIR`, `GAFFER_MODEL_REGISTRY`, `GAFFER_LOG`, `GAFFER_USAGE_LEDGER`, `MEMORY_CLI_BIN`, `MEMORY_MCP_BIN`, `DISPATCH_MCP_BIN`, `GAFFER_GH_BIN`, `DISPATCH_CLI`, `DISPATCH_CLI_BIN`, `MEMORY_CLI`, `GAFFER_BLOCK_LEDGER`, `GAFFER_SKILL_TELEMETRY`, `GAFFER_USAGE_PAUSE_FILE`, `GAFFER_EGRESS_ALLOW_FILE`, `GAFFER_SAFETY_HOOK`.
- **derived**: Computed from other knobs each time the config loads; set the knob they come from. `GAFFER_TICK_OUTER_TIMEOUT`, `GAFFER_POLL_WAIT_TIMEOUT`, `GAFFER_DOD_FEEDBACK_LINES`.
- **plumbing**: Set by the runner for a child process, the dashboard, an MCP server or the safety hook, never by you. `DISPATCH_PRODUCT_OWNER_CMD`, `DISPATCH_ONBOARD_CMD`, `DISPATCH_EPIC_FEATURE_CMD`, `DISPATCH_ONBOARD_NAME`, `DISPATCH_CORRELATION_ID`, `GAFFER_CLAIM_TOKEN`, `GAFFER_REVIEW_TICKET`, `GAFFER_DEFAULT_TICKET_REPO`, `GAFFER_TICKET`, `GAFFER_SANDBOX_PROFILE`.
- **packages**: Read inside the dispatch, memory and crew packages from their own environment; the runner never sets them. A few tune those packages, each read where it is named (an extra sensitive-path or test-path regex for the reviewer's risk flags and the gate-integrity check, the deletion size that is flagged, a hard observed-risk ceiling, the audit switches): set one in the environment that starts the package. `DISPATCH_AGENT_ID`, `DISPATCH_AUDIT`, `DISPATCH_AUDIT_OFF`, `DISPATCH_PID_FILE`, `DISPATCH_SENSITIVE_PATH_RE`, `DISPATCH_LARGE_DELETION_LINES`, `DISPATCH_OBSERVED_RISK_CEILING`, `GAFFER_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE_SEED`, `GAFFER_TEST_PATH_RE`, `MEMORY_AUDIT_OFF`, `MEMORY_NO_COLOR`, `MEMORY_REVIEW_NUDGE_EVERY_TIME`.
- **sandbox**: Inside-the-image details of the docker sandbox provider (runner/lib/sandbox-docker.sh, docs/sandbox.md). `GAFFER_SANDBOX_CLAUDE_BIN`, `GAFFER_SANDBOX_CLAUDE_CREDENTIALS`, `GAFFER_SANDBOX_HOME`, `GAFFER_SANDBOX_PATH`, `GAFFER_SANDBOX_NET_INT`, `GAFFER_SANDBOX_NET_UP`, `GAFFER_SANDBOX_PROXY`, `GAFFER_SANDBOX_PROXY_IMAGE`.
- **test seams**: read only so a test can shorten a wait, stub a command, skip slow bookkeeping or fix the clock; keep the built-in value. `GAFFER_DOD_OUTPUT_TAIL`, `GAFFER_DOD_RERUN_WAIT`, `GAFFER_DAEMON_MAX_CYCLES`, `GAFFER_DAEMON_SETUP_BACKOFF_MAX`, `GAFFER_TICK_DEADLINE_MARGIN`, `GAFFER_REAP_GRACE`, `GAFFER_LOCK_TIMEOUT`, `GAFFER_LOCK_STALE`, `GAFFER_REGISTRY_PROBE_TIMEOUT`, `GAFFER_DIGEST_DISABLE`, `GAFFER_USAGE_PAUSE_POLL_SECS`, `GAFFER_TODAY_OVERRIDE`, `GAFFER_CONTEXT_DUMP_DIR`, `GAFFER_WG_LIST_CMD`, `GAFFER_WG_SERVE_TIMEOUT`, `GAFFER_WG_SHOW_CMD`, `GAFFER_WG_DELIVERIES_CMD`, `GAFFER_TRUST_LOCK_TRIES`, `GAFFER_TRUST_LOCK_SLEEP_MS`, `GAFFER_TRUST_LOCK_STALE_MS`, `GAFFER_TRUST_WORKTREE_ROOT`, `GAFFER_CARD_BATCH`, `GAFFER_CARD_SNIPPET_CHARS`, `GAFFER_MERGE_TIMEOUT_MS`, `GAFFER_REAPPROVAL_BACKOFF_MS`, `GAFFER_DECOMPOSE_TIMEOUT_MS`, `GAFFER_PLAN_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS`, `GAFFER_TESTER_TIMEOUT_MS`, `GAFFER_ACCEPTANCE_PORT_BASE`, `GAFFER_REDACTION_MODULE`, `DISPATCH_TESTER_VERDICT_CMD`, `DISPATCH_LANE_VERDICT_CMD`, `DISPATCH_ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_CMD`, `GAFFER_KEEP_DELIVERY_BRANCH`, `GAFFER_PAUSE_KEEP_WORKTREE`, `GAFFER_UNIVERSAL_SKILLS`, `GAFFER_CLAUDE_VERSION`, `GAFFER_BP_FILE`, `DAILY_COUNTER_FILE`, `GAFFER_CLAIM_TTL`, `GAFFER_DOD_INSTALL_TIMEOUT`, `GAFFER_TEST_MERGE_CRASH_AFTER_LAND`.
